name: P2 Web shop checkout (saucedemo.com) (Capture)
description: Sign in to the demo shop, sort by price, put the cheapest products in the cart, check out, check the item total against the prices seen, finish and sign out. Web steps use captured objects (recorded with OOA Capture) instead of typed selectors where the element is fixed.

variables.name: folder
variables.description: Folder of these use cases, relative to the workspace (results go to its output folder).

variables.name: headless
variables.description: Run the browser without a window (for unattended runs).

variables.name: shop_user
variables.description: Demo user (printed on the shop's sign-in page).

variables.name: shop_password
variables.description: Demo password (printed on the shop's sign-in page). Real shops: use a Credential from the vault.

variables.name: items_to_buy
variables.description: How many of the cheapest products to buy.

variables.name: expected
variables.description: Sum of the prices of the products put in the cart.

variables.name: total_matches
variables.description: The shop's item total equals the prices seen.

variables.name: cart_count
variables.description: Products in the cart at checkout.
